overview: Six 3D voxel characters (Sam Sinclair, Space Penguins, Chupacabra, Mothman, Loveland Frogman and White Thang) built for The Sandbox, minted 22 July 2022 on The Sandbox's shared ASSET contract.

Primary sales settled in SAND on The Sandbox marketplace, off the ETH pipeline entirely. On-chain ETH secondary volume is negligible: only a couple of the six have ever changed hands, for a fraction of an ETH.

They did not ship alone. They arrived inside Steve Aoki's wider Sandbox collection, which went live on The Sandbox Marketplace on 25 September 2022 beside his own avatars, sneakers, gold records and jet, and buying any asset from it granted a Collector Badge worth 30 SAND. Aoki's Playhouse appeared in Sandbox Alpha Season 3 the same season.
The 1,050 pieces are edition counts across the six characters (200 each, except White Thang at 50), not 1,050 distinct artworks.
